The lighting is warm and natural, casting a soft glow on her skin and the surrounding deck equipment. (3) A high-angle drone or stabilized tracking shot follows the woman as she lies on her back and slides through a long, winding silver water slide. The slide curves across the ship's top deck, passing by numerous orange sun loungers and a turquoise circular hot tub. The vast ocean is visible in the background as the camera pans to capture her movement.
